key_insight: Molmo2 provides an open-weight, openly documented vision-language model and dataset that matches strong proprietary video-language capabilities while adding explicit grounding (spatial + temporal) for video understanding.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of fully open, reproducible video-language foundations: most top VLMs are proprietary or distilled from proprietary models and do not provide weights, data, or grounding capabilities needed for real-world applications.
method: Train a unified multimodal transformer on openly released image+video-caption and grounding annotations, combining contrastive, captioning, and grounding losses.
Incorporate temporal video encoding and localized grounding heads to predict spatial boxes and temporal spans aligned with language.
Release full training data, recipes, and model weights to enable reproducibility and further community research.
impact: Enables researchers and practitioners to build, evaluate, and extend state-of-the-art open VLMs with video understanding and localization — accelerating transparent progress in multimodal AI and downstream tasks (VQA, retrieval, robotics, accessibility).

paper_title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
paper_authors: Christopher Clark, Jieyu Zhang, Zixian Ma, Jae Sung Park, Mohammadreza Salehi
